header.baseline_source: FRESH real dweller tick 2026-10-21 ~12:21 EDT (transducer_v2_baseline.json); preflight clean (no [T]S4/[P]roton hits, :8080 ok)

ledger_matched_mu.split_note: TRANSMITTED (S21) = unsampled through-flow power in the component of the settled field parallel to the input wavefront; REFLECTED (S11) = the orthogonal (scattered) component of the unsampled through-flow. Modal proxy for port powers, stated as such.

radiative_exit.estimator: least squares on [1, I_tot, per-section shares of I], fit on 24 calibration trials (4 clean states x 6 jittered replicates, disjoint seeds)

scale_amplitude_sweep.bleed_note: bleed ratio at matched mu = RHO*(1-A(0.5)) = 0 by construction at every amplitude (definitional, not a stability finding); at mu_bad it is RHO*(1-A(0.05)) = 0.081 by definition.
